title: Can Rabbits Eat Cantaloupe Melons?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Cantaloupe Melon?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rccm-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-cantaloupe">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rccm-page,
    .rccm-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rccm-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rccm-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rccm-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rccm-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rccm-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rccm-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccm-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rccm-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rccm-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccm-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rccm-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rccm-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccm-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rccm-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccm-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rccm-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccm-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rccmFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rccm-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccm-hero-title-overlay .rccm-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rccm-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6.5vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rccm-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rccm-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rccm-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccm-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rccm-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 1.0;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccm-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rccm-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccm-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rccm-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccm-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rccm-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rccm-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rccm-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rccm-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccm-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rccm-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rccm-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rccm-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rccm-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rccm-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rccm-section h2,
    .rccm-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccm-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rccm-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rccm-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rccm-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccm-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccm-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rccm-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rccm-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rccm-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rccm-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rccm-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccm-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rccm-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rccm-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rccm-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccm-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rccm-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rccm-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rccm-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccm-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccm-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rccm-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rccm-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rccm-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccm-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rccm-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rccm-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rccm-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rccm-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rccm-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rccm-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rccm-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rccm-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rccm-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rccm-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccm-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rccm-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rccm-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccm-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rccm-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccm-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rccm-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rccm-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rccm-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rccm-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rccm-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rccm-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rccm-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rccm-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rccm-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccm-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rccm-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-cantaloupe.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rccm-final-box .rccm-pill,
    .rccm-final-box h2,
    .rccm-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rccm-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rccm-final-box .rccm-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rccm-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rccm-related,
    .rccm-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rccm-related .rccm-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rccm-related .rccm-section-header .rccm-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rccm-related .rccm-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rccm-related .rccm-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rccm-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rccm-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;

            <span class="rccm-pill">Rabbit food guide</span>
            <h2>Cantaloupe is one of the sweetest and wateriest fruits you can offer</h2>
            <p>
              Cantaloupe melon is a fragrant, orange-fleshed fruit that many rabbits find irresistible. Its sweet scent and soft texture tend to attract immediate interest, and the flesh is safe for rabbits in small amounts as an occasional treat.
            </p>
            <p>
              However, cantaloupe stands out from most other fruit treats because of just how high it is in both water and natural sugar. Its very high moisture content means even a small amount can loosen stools if a rabbit is not used to it, and the sugar content means overfeeding is a real risk with a fruit this appealing. Small portions and careful introduction are the keys to offering it safely.
            </p>

          <section class="rccm-panel" id="safe">
            <span class="rccm-pill">Safe in very small amounts</span>
            <h2>Is cantaloupe melon safe for rabbits?</h2>
            <p>
              Yes, the orange flesh of a ripe cantaloupe is safe for most healthy adult rabbits when offered in very small amounts. Only the flesh is appropriate, the rind and seeds should both be removed before feeding, as the tough, ridged rind is difficult to digest and the seeds are unnecessary.
            </p>
            <p>
              As always, hay should make up around 80–90% of a rabbit's daily food intake. Cantaloupe is a treat to be offered on top of a complete diet, not a substitute for leafy greens or vegetables. Because it is so moist and sweet, it warrants extra care with portion size compared to drier, less sugary fruits.
            </p>
          </section>

          <p>
            Because cantaloupe is so high in water and sugar, portions should be kept smaller than for most other fruits. One or two small cubes of flesh, roughly a teaspoon's worth, once a week is a sensible maximum for a healthy adult rabbit.

            <li>Feed cantaloupe no more than once a week.</li>

          <p>
            Unlike some fruits where only one part needs attention, cantaloupe has two parts to remove before feeding: the tough outer rind and the inner seeds. The flesh alone is what rabbits should eat.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rccm-warning-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Remove the rind completely</strong>
            Cantaloupe rind is tough, fibrous and difficult for a rabbit to digest properly. Always cut it away and serve only the soft orange flesh. Do not leave any rind attached to the edges of the piece.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Scoop out the seeds</strong>
            The soft seeds in the centre of the cantaloupe should be scooped out and discarded before cutting the flesh into serving pieces. The seeds are not acutely toxic but they are unnecessary and best avoided.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>No melon drinks or processed products</strong>
            Do not feed cantaloupe juice, melon-flavoured sweets, dried melon, tinned melon or any processed cantaloupe product. Only fresh, ripe, raw cantaloupe flesh is appropriate for rabbits.
          </li>
        </ul>

        <div class="rccm-panel">
          <span class="rccm-pill">A fragrant, popular treat</span>
          <h2>Most rabbits are drawn to cantaloupe immediately</h2>
          <p>
            The sweet fragrance of ripe cantaloupe tends to attract rabbits even before it is placed in front of them. Most will approach it eagerly and eat it quickly, which makes it one of the easier fruits to use as a gentle bonding or handling treat, but also one where portion discipline is especially important.
          </p>
          <p>
            Because cantaloupe is so moist, it is also worth removing any uneaten piece from the enclosure fairly quickly, soft, wet fruit left in warm conditions can spoil faster than drier treats and should not be left sitting for more than an hour or so.

    <section class="rccm-section rccm-prep rccm-reveal" id="prepare">
      <div class="rccm-wrap">
        <div class="rccm-section-header">
          <span class="rccm-pill">Simple preparation</span>
          <h2>How to prepare cantaloupe melon for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Preparing cantaloupe safely takes only a moment and the steps are consistent every time, rind off, seeds out, flesh portioned small.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rccm-steps">
          <article class="rccm-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Choose a ripe cantaloupe</h3>
            <p>Use a fresh, fully ripe cantaloupe with fragrant, deep orange flesh. Avoid overripe or watery-tasting fruit, and never use tinned or dried melon.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Remove rind and seeds</h3>
            <p>Cut away the rind completely and scoop out all seeds from the centre. Check no rind remains on the edges of the flesh before portioning.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Cut into small cubes</h3>
            <p>Slice the flesh into small, clearly portioned cubes, around a teaspoon's worth in total. Do not offer a full wedge or slice.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Serve and remove promptly</h3>
            <p>Offer one or two cubes and remove any uneaten cantaloupe after an hour, as the soft, moist flesh spoils quickly in warm conditions.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rccm-section rccm-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rccm-wrap">
        <div class="rccm-section-header">
          <span class="rccm-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys cantaloupe</h2>
          <p>
            When offered in the right amounts, cantaloupe can be one of the most enthusiastically received treats in your rotation. The challenge is keeping the portions firmly small despite that enthusiasm.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rccm-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Highly attractive to most rabbits</h3>
            <p>The sweet fragrance and soft texture of cantaloupe make it one of the most immediately appealing fruit treats you can offer.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Good source of vitamin A</h3>
            <p>The beta-carotene in cantaloupe's orange flesh is one of its nutritional highlights, complementing a diet already built on hay and greens.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Hydrating in small amounts</h3>
            <p>The high water content can contribute a small hydration boost alongside fresh water, though it also means portions must stay very small.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Bonding treat</h3>
            <p>Because rabbits tend to respond to cantaloupe eagerly, it works well as a calm, positive interaction treat during handling or grooming.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may come over as soon as it smells the melon, eat it quickly, look for more or sniff around the feeding spot afterwards.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rccm-benefit">
            <h3>Remove leftovers promptly</h3>
            <p>Unlike drier treats, any uneaten cantaloupe should be removed within an hour to prevent it spoiling in the enclosure.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rccm-faq rccm-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Cantaloupe melon for rabbits FAQs">
      <div class="rccm-narrow">
        <div class="rccm-panel">
          <div class="rccm-section-header">
            <span class="rccm-pill">FAQs</span>
            <h2>Cantaloupe melon for rabbits FAQs</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding cantaloupe melon to rabbits safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rccm-faq-list">
            <details class="rccm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat cantaloupe melon?</summary>
              <p>Yes, rabbits can eat fresh cantaloupe flesh in very small amounts. It should be an occasional treat only, with the rind and seeds removed before feeding.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rccm-faq-item">
              <summary>How much cantaloupe can a rabbit have?</summary>
              <p>A sensible maximum for most healthy adult rabbits is one or two small cubes of cantaloupe flesh, roughly a teaspoon in total, no more than once a week.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rccm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat cantaloupe rind?</summary>
              <p>No, cantaloupe rind should be removed. It is tough, fibrous and difficult for rabbits to digest, so only the soft orange flesh should be offered.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rccm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat cantaloupe seeds?</summary>
              <p>Cantaloupe seeds are best avoided. They are unnecessary and should be scooped out before the flesh is cut into small pieces for your rabbit.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rccm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can baby rabbits eat cantaloupe?</summary>
              <p>Baby rabbits should not be given cantaloupe. Young rabbits have sensitive digestive systems and should stay on an appropriate hay-based diet recommended for their age.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rccm-final rccm-reveal">
      <div class="rccm-wrap rccm-final-box">
        <span class="rccm-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Cantaloupe can be a safe and very popular rabbit treat in tiny amounts</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat cantaloupe melon flesh in small amounts, and most find it genuinely irresistible. It is one of the sweeter and waterier fruits in this guide series, which means the preparation steps, rind off, seeds out, portions small, need to be followed consistently every time.
        </p>
        <p>
          Keep portions to one or two small cubes once a week at most, introduce it gradually the first time, and always remove any uneaten piece promptly. Never feed the rind, seeds or any processed melon product. As with all fruit, cantaloupe is a treat on top of a diet that must be based firmly on hay, with leafy greens and vegetables providing the daily nutrition.
        </p>
